messages.subject: Planned DMS maintenance — Saturday 4 May, 22:00-02:00
messages.plaintextBody:
Colleagues,

The document management system will be unavailable this Saturday from 22:00 to 02:00 for scheduled maintenance and a security patch. Please save and check in any open documents before 21:30. Email and the case-management system are unaffected.

Thanks,
IT Helpdesk | Whitfield Carter LLP
